task.question: What opens at São Paulo/Guarulhos International Airport in February 2026?
task.evidence: 21 February – GRU Airport People Mover opens in São Paulo/Guarulhos International Airport.
task.sonnet_answer: Terminal 4 at São Paulo/Guarulhos International Airport is scheduled to open in February 2026.

answer:

Let me think about this. Based on my knowledge, GRU Airport (São Paulo/Guarulhos International Airport) has been undergoing expansions. There have been announcements about a new terminal or facility opening there.

From my knowledge, Terminal 4 (T4) at GRU Airport is scheduled to open in February 2026. This new terminal is part of the airport's expansion project under the management of GRU Airport (Aeroportos Brasil Viracopos was separate, but GRU is managed by Grupo Corporativo Comporte/CCR).

FINAL: Terminal 4 (T4)
